study type: Secondary data analysis of a national hospital-based survey
cohort: 2,623 pregnant women with less than 37 weeks of gestational age from the "Birth in Brazil" survey (2011-2012).
finding: The use of ANC among Brazilian pregnant women was low (31.8%), with lower rates observed in vaginal deliveries and among women living in the countryside.
mod_finding: ANC use was lower in vaginal deliveries (23.9%) compared to those who did not go into labor (43.8%).
